provenance.section_title: Goal 7: Reduce the risk of health care–associated infections

rules.rationale: HAIs are a patient safety issue affecting all types of health care organizations.
rules.citation: According to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, each year, millions of people acquire an infection while receiving care, treatment, and services in a health care organization.

provenance.section_title: Goal 7: Reduce the risk of health care–associated infections
Goal 7: Reduce the risk of health care–associated infections

rules.rationale: Compliance with CDC and/or WHO hand hygiene guidelines is required to reduce the risk of HAIs.
rules.citation: Comply with either the current Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) and/or the current World Health Organization (WHO) hand hygiene guidelines.

provenance.section_title: Goal 7: Reduce the risk of health care–associated infections

rules.rationale: Organizations should assess their compliance with CDC and/or WHO guidelines through a comprehensive program.
rules.citation: To ensure compliance with this National Patient Safety Goal, an organization should assess its compliance with the CDC and/or WHO guidelines through a comprehensive program that provides a hand hygiene policy, fosters a culture of hand hygiene, monitors compliance, and provides feedback.

rules.rationale: Organizations should set goals for improving compliance with hand hygiene guidelines.
rules.citation: Set goals for improving compliance with hand hygiene guidelines.

rules.rationale: Organizations should improve compliance with hand hygiene guidelines based on established goals.
rules.citation: Improve compliance with hand hygiene guidelines based on established goals.
